_instructions: CRITICAL: keep this package app-partner bounded; external surfaces are included only as proven mandatory Partner counterparts and never as independent product scope.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines authority precedence, CODE_BASED_LEAN and derived-plan limits.
evidenceIndex.result: Current Product Truth, machine contracts and code/data evidence outrank this package; unrelated areas cannot be pulled in by planning convenience.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines exact-ref pinning, evidence-first diagnosis, existing-package reconciliation and final-candidate discipline.
evidenceIndex.result: Existing app-partner package was rebaselined instead of replaced and is pinned to BB@629b86b9a3ca8fadc16158b6c9a078217ebe4af4.

evidenceIndex.claim: Current architecture artifact was inspected on BB.
evidenceIndex.result: The file is populated ArchPulse-generated draw.io XML and is usable as dependency evidence; the old zero-byte claim is obsolete.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Generated architecture evidence does not override governance, contracts or source.

evidenceIndex.claim: Shows current Partner mobile runtime composition.
evidenceIndex.result: SecureStore Identity session storage, stable device fingerprint, native catalog picker, Partner push registration and partner/app-partner IdentitySessionGate wrap DshPartnerSurface.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Static composition does not prove live session or device recovery.

evidenceIndex.claim: Shows current Partner surface registry and shared composition.
evidenceIndex.result: Partner routes cover entry/orders/support/catalog/team/wallet/commercial flows; surface state composes canonical profile/store/order/support/team models and Store context is re-read from DSH.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Frontend wiring does not prove backend/database invariants.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines Partner onboarding/publication ownership and mandatory counterparts.
evidenceIndex.result: Capability is READY_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION; app-partner is primary Partner consumer while Field/operator/client slices are required only for the same onboarding/publication lifecycle; DSH owns Partner/Store state and WLT payout truth.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines support/rescue ownership and required counterpart surfaces.
evidenceIndex.result: Capability is DISCOVERY; Partner support is Store/order scoped, operator owns incident/rescue transitions, and WLT is visibility-only from DSH rescue.

evidenceIndex.claim: Reproduces selected-Store analytics ambiguity on current BB.
evidenceIndex.result: UI receives/re-renders on canonicalStoreId and labels Store scope, but fetchPartnerPerformance sends period only; backend resolves storeID independently through partnerStore.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Does not by itself choose the intended product semantic.

evidenceIndex.result: DSH sections are administration, analytics, catalogs, dashboard, hr, login, marketing, operations, partners, platform and support; WLT has finance.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Directory presence is not relevance by itself.

evidenceIndex.result: Wallet, ledger, COD, settlement, commission and payout truth remain WLT-owned; Partner/DSH may use bounded contracts/readbacks only.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Each financial path still requires runtime/database/reconciliation evidence.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines contract, persistence, idempotency, actor/object isolation and sensitive-data rules.
evidenceIndex.result: Partner/Store scope must be authorized server-side; state changes require canonical persistence/readback and sensitive financial truth cannot move to DSH/frontend.

evidenceIndex.claim: Reconciles the stale package with current BB and the final concurrent delta.
evidenceIndex.result: BB advanced hundreds of commits with direct Partner/runtime/backend/test/architecture changes; the final two commits affected migration governance and root-closure tooling rather than Partner route/UI semantics.
evidenceIndex.limitations: BB must be re-resolved again before implementation writes and final decision.

entries.name: bthwani2-boop/bthwani-suite-next
entries.summary: Repository is the bounded evidence source; implementation remains restricted to Partner-proven paths.

entries.name: control-panel
entries.summary: Only Partner-specific operator counterparts are in scope: onboarding/roles, publication/catalog/serviceability, order/handoff/support readback, Partner analytics and WLT finance. Generic Control Panel work is excluded.

entries.name: app-client
entries.summary: Only mandatory Partner-originated publication/order/custody/support readback compatibility is in scope; all independent Client commerce is excluded.

entries.name: app-partner
entries.summary: Primary product scope: Partner Identity/readiness, Store scope, orders, catalog/publication, team/fleet, custody/support, finance readback and analytics/commercial readback.

entries.name: app-captain
entries.summary: Only the counterpart of Partner fleet binding, Store-Captain custody/handoff and governed support compatibility is in scope; Captain workforce, independent delivery UX and finance are excluded.

entries.name: app-field
entries.summary: Only Partner onboarding/evidence required by the same activation/publication lifecycle is in scope; Field workforce and unrelated operations are excluded.

entries.name: administration
entries.summary: Only Partner role/permission behavior that gates Partner access/team operations is included.

entries.name: analytics
entries.summary: Only compatibility with Partner/Store analytics facts and the selected-Store contract is included.

entries.name: catalogs
entries.summary: Only central catalog/publication controls that directly affect Partner assortment/media/stock/price and Store publication are included.

entries.name: dashboard
entries.summary: Generic dashboard is not a canonical Partner writer or mandatory Partner journey surface.
entries.exclusionReason: No current Partner Product Truth or source evidence makes the generic dashboard a required writer/readback for this package.
entries.reopenTrigger: Reopen only if current pinned evidence proves a specific dashboard operation is mandatory to a Partner transition or readback.

entries.name: hr
entries.summary: Workforce HR is not Partner business/team truth.
entries.exclusionReason: Partner/Store/team lifecycle is owned through Identity/DSH Partner boundaries; generic Workforce HR belongs to other actor employment profiles.
entries.reopenTrigger: Reopen only if current Product Truth explicitly assigns a Partner journey invariant to this HR section.

entries.name: login
entries.summary: Generic operator login does not own app-partner session or Partner state.
entries.exclusionReason: App-partner Identity/session behavior is governed by the Partner runtime and Identity boundary, not the Control Panel login section.
entries.reopenTrigger: Reopen only if current pinned implementation proves this section directly gates a Partner-specific operator action required by a unit.

entries.name: marketing
entries.summary: Only Partner Store visibility/publication gates and Partner offers proven to affect publication are included.

entries.name: operations
entries.summary: Only Partner order decisions, custody/handoff exceptions and governed order rescue counterparts are included.

entries.name: partners
entries.summary: Direct Partner onboarding/review, Store linking, activation and Partner fleet operator readback are included.

entries.name: platform
entries.summary: Only serviceability/capacity/delivery-mode policy that gates a Partner Store's readiness/publication/fulfillment is included.

entries.name: support
entries.summary: Operator support/incident/rescue counterpart for Partner tickets/orders is included; unrelated support administration is excluded.

entries.name: finance
entries.summary: Only WLT-owned Partner COD/settlement/commission/payout controls and audit/readback required by Partner finance are included.

entries.name: DSH_SHARED_FRONTEND
entries.summary: Only shared modules imported by Partner flows or serving canonical Partner contracts are included.

entries.name: DSH_BACKEND
entries.summary: Canonical Partner operational APIs, authorization and DSH orchestration are in scope; unrelated backend domains are not.

entries.name: DSH_DATABASE
entries.summary: Only persistence/migrations/invariants required by Partner/Store/order/team/fleet/custody/support facts are in scope.

entries.name: WLT_RELATED
entries.summary: Partner payout prerequisites and Partner finance/COD truth are in scope only at WLT-owned boundaries.

entries.name: CONTRACTS_AND_CLIENTS
entries.summary: OpenAPI/operation IDs/generated clients directly used by included Partner slices must stay aligned.

entries.name: EVENTS_JOBS_INTEGRATIONS
entries.summary: Only events/jobs/reconciliation directly emitted or consumed by Partner state-changing journeys are included.

entries.name: IDENTITY_AUTHORIZATION_SECURITY
entries.summary: Partner role/session/trusted context/Store/object isolation and Partner financial access controls are mandatory.

entries.name: TESTS_AND_QUALITY
entries.summary: Targeted contract/domain/database/runtime/RTL/accessibility verification is included only for affected Partner slices.

entries.name: RUNTIME_AND_OBSERVABILITY
entries.summary: Partner mobile session/device/push, API correlation and canonical readback require runtime evidence.

entries.name: CI_TOOLING_AUTOMATION
entries.summary: Only existing guards/CI/checks required to prove affected Partner paths are included; unrelated tool cleanup is excluded.

entries.name: GOVERNANCE_AND_OWNERSHIP
entries.summary: Only authority, policies and Product Truth that constrain included Partner slices are in scope; derived plans cannot create requirements.
